description_en: Removes multiple hosts from an asset group at a time
description_zh: 从指定资产组中批量移除主机
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost remove-hosts-from-group --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --host-group-id 1 --host-ids '["1","2","3"]' --region cn-hangzhou
name: RemoveHostsFromGroup

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the bastion host whose asset group you want to manage.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to query the bastion host ID
parameters.help_zh:
要移除主机的资产组所在堡垒机的实例ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host whose asset group you want to manage.

For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
要移除主机的资产组所在堡垒机的区域ID。
区域ID和区域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the asset group from which you want to remove hosts.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/201307.html operation to query the asset group ID
parameters.help_zh:
要移除主机的资产组ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/201307.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: host_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The IDs of the hosts that you want to remove from the host group. Specify a JSON string. You can specify up to 100 host IDs.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/200665.html operation to query the host IDs
parameters.help_zh:
要移除的主机ID。该参数为JSON格式的字符串，最多支持输入100个主机ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/200665.html接口获取主机ID
parameters.name: host_ids
